text: {"level":"HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL","categories":["TRADE_SECRET"],"evidence":[{"quote":"Sourcing notes (internal)","supports_axis":"level","supports_value":"HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL"},{"quote":"We secured an exclusive, multi-year supply of the key input at roughly 18.6% below market by co-investing in the supplier's second line.","supports_axis":"category","supports_value":"TRADE_SECRET"},{"quote":"In return they will not sell that grade to our competitors.","supports_axis":"category","supports_value":"TRADE_SECRET"},{"quote":"The yield curve we negotiated is what protects our margin.","supports_axis":"category","supports_value":"TRADE_SECRET"}],"rationale":"The document contains non-public procurement and pricing terms (exclusive supply, below-market pricing, negotiated yield curve and restrictions on competitor sales) that are strategic, secret commercial information and could cause severe competitive harm if disclosed.","level_confidence":"high","category_confidence":"high","insufficient_information":false}
